standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: Let me out! Let me out! When I get out of this crate, I'm going to give that axe merchant a piece of my mind.

standard-dialogue.player: That's exactly why I'm not letting you out. You've caused enough trouble as it is.

standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: I didn't do anything at all! All I wanted was a monkey-sized battle axe and when I found one, that human started yelling and throwing things at me.

standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: I even offered to pay for it but he wouldn't accept my money.

standard-dialogue.player: I mean you did try to steal his stuff first. Perhaps you should be more honest next time?

standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: But I'm a paying customer! I have rights! He can't treat me like that!

standard-dialogue.player: sigh* If I put in a word with his manager, would that satisfy you?

standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: Only if I get compensation too!

standard-dialogue.player: I'll see what I can do.

using-bob-s-caged-monkey-on-an-affected-.text: There is already a monkey in that cage!
